result.text: Completed the requested bounded verification in the existing 390×844 browser session. No settings were changed, no source files were edited, and no build/publishing/store actions were taken; only the requested atlas-viewer Reset controls were used. **Settings alignment:** Appearance card bounds were x=20–370 (center x=195). The combined English/Español bounds were x=79–311 (center x=195; horizontal offset **0.0px**). The Haptics On/Off bounds were x=95–295 (center x=195; horizontal offset **0.0px**). Both pairs are centered within 1px. Language options were 112×44px each; haptics options were 96×44px each. English and On remained selected. **Heart source and zoom:** The baseline heart SVG matched the specified source master’s first `path d`, with `viewBox="0 0 1450 1000"`, 29 paths, and no embedded ``. SVG and surface dimensions progressed from 283.918×195.805px at 1× to 425.876×293.708 at 1.5×, 567.8×391.6 at 2×, 851.8×587.4 at 3×, and 1135.67×783.22 at 4×. The rounded mask scaled from about 7px to 28px. At 4×, panning shifted surface, canvas, and marker together; Reset restored scale 1, zero translation, and baseline dimensions/marker size. **Exact Servier pelvis source and zoom:** Scoped via `image-details-asset-servier-pelvis` and its two ancestors (not the paired-hip plate). The inline SVG matched the genuine `servier-pelvis.svg` first `path d`, had `viewBox="0 0 256 294"`, 253 paths, and no embedded ``. It is the tall anterior pelvis/sacrum/femurs artwork. Dimensions progressed from 202.5×232.559px at 1× to 303.75×348.838 at 1.5×, 405×465.12 at 2×, 607.5×697.7 at 3×, and 810×930.234 at 4×. The rounded mask scaled from 5px to 20px. Pan moved the surface, canvas, and marker together (+40,+22px); Reset restored scale 1, zero translation, and baseline geometry. **Optional Gray raster check:** The neighboring vertebral-column image is an `` with native dimensions **233×800**. At 4× it rendered about 377.45×1296px; the browser screenshot shows the expected softness/aliasing of a finite scan compared with the SVGs. This is browser evidence only, not physical-iPhone proof.
